annotations.text:
Saqqa dashboard restyle · three minimal directions, sketch fidelity.
A Paper: the deck's own system (paper, ink, one blue, hairlines, no cards). Coherent across deck, video and demo; quietest.
B Instrument: dark monochrome readout, one colour reserved for the decision. Closest to today's layout, all badges and pills removed; best on video.
C Ledger: the twelve trips as a financial ledger first, evidence beneath. Strongest for an auditor; least visual for a demo.
References: Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Notion — typography-led, whitespace as the design, one accent.
